game.name: Ultima VIII - Pagan (1994) (Origin Systems) (French).dosz
game.comment: Installed v2.12 using Redump-verified CD-ROM: Ultima VIII - Pagan (USA) (En,Fr,De) (Rerelease) Run "install french" at command line in D: Install options: Source Drive: D:\FRANCAIS (Default) Destination Drive: C:\ULTIMA8 (Default) Sound Card: Sound Blaster Pro, 16/16ASP - Port 0x0220, IRQ 7, DMA 1 Music Card: Sound Blaster Pro - Port 0x0220 Then run D:\FRNSPCH\INSTALL.EXE to install the Speech Pack Requires INSTALL.EXE from English installation DoDAT cannot build this directly from the disc image Also matches with GOG
game.comment_dosc: Auto-starts, direct mouse enabled, and Sound Blaster Pro config. General MIDI option
